blocks.text: THE EXPERIMENT RAN.THE DECISION NEEDS A RECEIPT.
Long-horizon agents generate events. Proofpress makes the useful conclusion scoped, reviewable, and safe for a fresh session to inherit.
What can the next agent safely inherit?
Choose one experiment first. Open lineage only when you need to inspect how the decision was made.
This is the result a fresh agent may want to reuse. The ledger keeps it attached to its measured run and review state.
Candidate B is eligible for review.
Evidence is present, the experiment completed, and the metric is measured. A human or policy reviewer still decides whether this belongs in shared knowledge.
The decision is a path, not a note.
Every reusable claim keeps its source, experiment, evidence status, review state, and the prior knowledge it builds on.
